title: Public Knowledge Synthesis, Civic Decision Literacy, Reader Navigation, Content Closure And Evergreen Stewardship
decision_boundary: This registry does not create a new evidence claim, recommendation, authorization, reader classification, comprehension finding, accessibility certification, translation equivalence, content-completeness declaration, deletion, archive action, evergreen-truth finding, receipt, score, rank, Phase 64 advance, or operating-outcome decision.
